OpenRouter What you get: One year of no platform or BYOK fees and $100 in OpenRouter credits ($650 value) What it is: OpenRouter gives you one API and one bill for hundreds of AI models. You can pick your model or let it choose the best one per prompt. Trying a model that just came out is a one-line change. You can also set spend limits per API key, control which providers see your data, and automatically swap models if one goes down. Why I love it: Our team has been an OpenRouter customer for about a year and a half. They make it easy to choose the right mix of quality and cost for everything we do, and being able to try out new models super quickly is so delightful. There’s a reason Stripe just acquired them for billions. How people use OpenRouter: Scaling from 11B to 1T+ monthly tokens while cutting cost per token ~60% Running a 35K-player game on 28+ models through one API Getting new models to users within hours of launch Capping spend on every key to avoid surprise bills Giving engineers open models their cloud doesn’t offer yet Rerouting 640K failed requests a month so users never see an outage Running a medtech company’s AI in the EU with zero data retention 2. Ploy What you get: One year free of Ploy Starter ($600 value) What it is: Ploy runs growth marketing for you. Point it at your website and it learns your brand, design, and business. Then AI agents build landing pages, launch ad campaigns, and grow organic traffic from Google and AI search. Watch the video below to see it in action. Why I love it: We did a poll within my newsletter Slack community, and Ploy was one of the most requested new products to join the Product Pass. This is one of those magical AI products that change how you think about what AI can do for you. How people use Ploy: Turning a research report into an interactive lead magnet and launching a 40+ skill marketplace in a month at Clay Shipping on-brand ABM pages at scale at Hex Enabling AEs to turn discovery calls into buyer-ready business cases and deal pages at Avoca Redesigning Volca’s whole site in days instead of paying an agency $30K Fixing the website and SEO at Once Reading Building a site chatbot and calculator at PEC360 3. Sentry What you get: One year of Sentry Team in credits ($360 value) What it is: Sentry shows developers and builders what’s broken in their code and helps them fix it fast. Why I love it: We’ve been Sentry customers for almost a year now, and rely on it to keep the Product Pass humming along. The in-depth details that Sentry provides help us quickly get to the root cause of issues and fix them. Such a good product. How people use Sentry: Getting an alert the moment something breaks in production, with error monitoring Gergely Orosz fixing a production bug with an AI-drafted PR Watching a replay of exactly what a user hit Following a slow request across services with tracing Swapping console.log for logs you can actually search Catching runaway AI token costs with alerts and tracing Sending errors to coding agents that open PRs for review, like Factory and Exa Grab your codes 4.
